correctness.rationale: The exact paperfolding bit recurrence gives exhaustive maps from parity-indexed length-L profile sets to both parity-indexed length-2L sets. Base length four is fully classified from all four possible adjacent pairs at both index parities, with explicit witnesses. At all longer dyadic lengths the opposite positional-sum parities make extreme-weight maps injectively disjoint, while the central groups merge into a single arithmetic progression with one added endpoint per doubling. The identities for scattered length-two subsequence counts prove equivalence with the (weight, positional-sum) profile. Attached standalone code checks exact sets through k=12 and independently scans direct factors through k=10; finite scans supplement but do not replace the infinite induction.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The older paperfolding theorem implies only that the three values of weight are present, not that the extreme groups each split into \(2^k\) scattered-pair classes and the center into \(k+1\). Contiguous length-two factor counts (2-abelian) and scattered length-two counts (2-binomial) are distinct relations, without a general implication giving this profile. Run reductions discard lengths of runs, while scattered counts retain positional information. Stronger factor complexity does not by itself recover quotient class cardinalities.

originality.rationale: Searches against exact formula, scattered-subsequence and positional-moment aliases, relevant indexed results, an existing paperfolding 2-abelian claim, the named full primary papers and OEIS found no prior statement that determines the dyadic 2-binomial class profile of the ordinary paperfolding word. The nearest paperfolding theorem proves the coarser abelian result (three dyadic weights); the known run-reduced and contiguous-2-abelian invariants are not equivalent to scattered-2-binomial equivalence. The numerical values appear under a purely arithmetic OEIS interpretation; that does not give the factor-class theorem. This is a best-knowledge assessment and cannot prove universal novelty.
residual_risks: Search and database coverage cannot rule out an unindexed equivalent statement, a thesis appendix, or inaccessible full text.
A numerical sequence already occurs at OEIS A006127; mathematical novelty is the paperfolding class interpretation and its proof, not the integer formula as an arithmetic identity.

value.rationale: At dyadic lengths the published ordinary abelian complexity is just three, but the natural scattered-length-two refinement has exact linear-order complexity \(2^{k+1}+k+1\). The theorem gives a complete weight-resolved quotient spectrum and a structural explanation of its logarithmic central contribution for infinitely many lengths. It is neither a small finite table nor a routine restatement of 2-regularity; the profile recursion can inform refined complexity calculations for other digit-recursive words.
